summary: Backend API testing completed for Grocery Sales Analytics - Daily Sales Report Auto-Generation feature. All 18 tests passed covering upload-sales-data, previous-financial-data, generate-daily-report, extract-canteen-summary, and financial-data-range endpoints.

minor.issue: No root health check endpoint exists - returns 404. Not a functional issue, just missing convenience endpoint.

seed_data_creation: Test data created via Excel upload with unique future dates (2026-05-11, 2026-07-20, 2026-10-28) to avoid conflicts
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints for daily sales report auto-generation feature are working correctly. Tests cover: (1) POST /api/upload-sales-data with daily upload_type and data_date, (2) GET /api/previous-financial-data returns found=false for empty DB and correct values when prior data exists, (3) POST /api/generate-daily-report generates valid PDF and saves financial_data record, (4) POST /api/extract-canteen-summary accepts image files and returns 422 when no file provided, (5) GET /api/financial-data-range retrieves financial records by date range. E2E test verified the complete flow: upload → get previous data → generate report → verify persistence → verify retrieval for next day.
